steps.name: Candela
steps.text: *Cough*... Testing, 1, 2, 3. Can you hear me?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: My dear citizens and friends, as well as our beloved tourists from afar, Candela speaking.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: First, please don't be alarmed.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: I will admit that I did not see Old Pancho's plan coming.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: I never expected that my trusted subordinate would do something as horrifying as to plot against me to take this city. How terrifying!

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: However, as I said in the beginning, this is no cause for alarm.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Rather, I must give Pancho my thanks.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: To be honest, I've been wondering for the past two years what we could do to make the championship more exciting, more eye-opening, and more thrilling to all of us.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: And I've never found a particularly nice way to do this.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Yet Pancho's found it. Through his actions, he's putting on an even more exciting championship!

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Think the championship's over?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: No, not at all. At that very moment, our championship has reached its true climax!

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: At this point in time, all teams are revived, and betting has reopened.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Stop the troublemakers that are sowing chaos in the city to the best of your ability. I know you can.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: And once everything comes to a successful conclusion, you will be adequately rewarded.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Oh, you must be the ones. My subordinates told me you helped them foil a plan to assassinate me.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Come, sit with me. As your reward, you may sit here in the front row to enjoy this match with me.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Are you... serious?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Of course. I'm always serious.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Pancho knows he wouldn't stand much of a chance if he flipped the table right in front of me.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: And that's why he's holing up in the ship I entrusted to him.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: And if my guess is correct, he probably added quite a few features to it in secret. Maybe a cannon or two?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But if that was all there was to it, it would hardly be a threat.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Between the second and third rounds, we invite dignitaries from all factions to board the ship so they may enjoy the competition in person.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Oh, I see. The dignitaries. That's the key here.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The city's operations depend on dealing with them.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Right, right, right. It isn't a matter of whether I want to solve this problem of his or not, but whether the bigwigs' underlings want me to solve his problem right away.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Tsk, making such a huge ruckus, only by playing dirty.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: It was probably Ernesto who taught him that.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Well, as you can see, there isn't much I can do, and there isn't much that he can do either.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: In that case, we might as well make things more interesting.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Wouldn't that be provoking him...?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: If he actually dragged the brass hats out to slaughter one by one, he wouldn't be doing much with the city even if I handed him the keys.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You don't get it, Missy. He wants to take over the city and take it to war, so he needs the big shots' backing.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Otherwise, he wouldn't have the money or manpower to actually go to war.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And if I had to guess, some of the big shots on the ship might already have come to an agreement with him.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Oh? Now I'm taking an interest in you young ladies. From the way you are dressed, I suppose you're not from Bolívar?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Haha, we are from Lungmen, and two of our friends happen to be on the ship.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Hm? So you are friends of Ch'en and Lin? They didn't mention you at all.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: We didn't tell them we'd be here on a vacation, so that makes sense.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Hahaha, I see.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: In that case, let me tell you one more thing—

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: I gave Ch'en and Lin this mission, but I also promised Lady Fumizuki that they would not come to harm during their stay here.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Do you know what that means?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It means it's not yet time.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: You know your stuff, young lady of Higashi.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: And if something does happen to them, then I'm afraid the old men on the ship will find themselves lost at sea, thanks to Pancho.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Missy, don't be scared.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Come, come. They say that it takes a fight to get to know each other. It just happens there's one unfolding before us. Come, sit down. Let's talk.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You done?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Done.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Things don't look good here, though.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Looks like having you deal with Ernesto while I investigate didn't save us enough time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Not happy about it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Not one bit... but not much I can do.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: This whole affair isn't all that simple. We knew that ahead of time, no?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I didn't expect things to get so out of hand, though.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You scared?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where are you now?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: In one of the cabins.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I took a stroll around while you had your chat with Ernesto. The atmosphere wasn't all that tense before Pancho put his plans in motion, though.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But right after his speech, the crew and the sailors started to make their move.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The whole ship is on high alert now, and they are very well-supplied and well-equipped.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sounds like you're ready for a seesaw battle?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: We aren't completely out of options just yet.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How do you figure?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: They locked all the dignitaries in a single room.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Common practice among thugs... Hold on.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Let's start with the hostages.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Looks like you figured it out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It doesn't matter how many weapons they have on the ship, how well supplied they are, and how many men they have to support them on land, Lady Candela has control here. The best outcome he can hope for is a draw.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The odds will be against him if it drags out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: These hostages are basically his lifeline.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Heh, that's right. These dignitaries are high officials in the three governments.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: As hostages, they really help keep things in check.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It doesn't take very long. All he needs is a brief moment, he just needs Lady Candela to hesitate for a second.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Then he'll get to do so much more. He'll have so many more bargaining chips.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But there's only the two of us here.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: To be honest, I really am not into the idea of playing hero of justice with you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll do it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll get their attention and leave the hostages to you.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That could work. There should be a lifeboat on the ship, or we could make them jump into the sea and swim.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What happens after that?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You'll run after everyone's rescued?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you want to stay on the ship and play the hero, feel free.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I guess that's how it'll go, then.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: So, should we begin?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Let's do it. Right, don't hang up. Stay in touch with me.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Ugh...? Where am I...?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Hermano, are you okay?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: That Ch'en woman knocked you out.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Oh, right... Now I remember...

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: What's the situation?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Things are proceeding according to plan. A few of the bigwigs have already agreed to help Papa.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Wait, where's Ch'en?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: It seems she's been causing a ruckus all over the ship after knocking you out. Papa ordered everyone to find and capture her.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Causing a ruckus... No.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Rafaela, check the hostage holding area right away.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Ch'en might be creating an opening for Lin.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: We're in trouble if they manage to save the hostages.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: But what about you...?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I'm fine. Now go.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: An old friend once told me, I have to take a beating before I can learn, like a young her, that being a stubborn ass is just a stupid impulse.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And even now, I've got no idea what kind of stubbornness I'm supposed to stick to and what counts as an unrealistic, stupid impulse.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But my guess is she probably knows that's not enough to stop me, or my name isn't Ch'en Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Good for you, Miss Ch'en. You know what you are doing and what you must do.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But me?
Ernesto struggles to his feet and stumbles out of the room.
